_source: Argentina's Secretariat of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries (MAGyP), report 'Márgenes y Resultados', June 2026, Zona Núcleo region (p. 8). https://www.magyp.gob.ar/sitio/areas/analisis_economico/margenes/
freight_in_marketing_source: CATAC reference freight, ~110 km Pergamino to Rosario Up-River (provisional)
_price_point_note: MAGyP prices are Bolsa de Cereales quotes at Rosario or Bahía Blanca port for the harvest month (MAGyP, 'Metodología para el Cálculo y Resultados Agrícolas', June 2025, p. 3), and its 'gastos de comercialización y cosecha' include the trip to that port. The report does not break that item down (checked June 2026 report and the June 2025 methodologies), so the freight inside it is the region's CATAC reference freight, provisional until read in the CATAC table.
_review: Not checked against the publication yet (reviewer, 2026-10-27): figures are provisional. The costs do not reproduce gross_margin_in_report (corn and soybean differ by more than 100 USD/ha).
